acceptance.title: Local evidence, scopes, jobs and baselines
acceptance.evidence: Existing Python and browser acceptance tests; offline execution only.

acceptance.title: Backup, restore and optional PostgreSQL
acceptance.evidence: SQLite snapshots and isolated PostgreSQL integration checks completed.

acceptance.title: Findings, triage, retest and stakeholder reports
acceptance.evidence: API checks cover source identity, permissions, revision conflicts and closure evidence.

acceptance.title: Requirements coverage and offline mode acceptance
acceptance.evidence: Coverage browser checks and one persisted offline result scenario per mode pass. This does not establish completion of every original blueprint milestone.

acceptance.title: Snapshot-consistent enumeration
acceptance.evidence: Freeze runs/jobs/artifacts/baselines/audit pages for five minutes. Workspace selection and live mode retain offset semantics.

acceptance.title: Scheduled reversible retention
acceptance.evidence: Scheduling, persistent intervals and baseline protection pass on SQLite/PostgreSQL.

acceptance.title: Scrum backlogs, sprint board and reviews
acceptance.evidence: Browser/API checks cover planning, Done criteria, child work, progress and reviews.

acceptance.title: Declarative recorded JSON invariants
acceptance.evidence: Typed comparisons preserve unknown/error outcomes and reject incompatible baselines.

acceptance.title: Permanent deletion lifecycle
acceptance.evidence: Reviewed run/artifact deletion, SQLite/PostgreSQL recovery and managed backup expiry pass. Live deletion and expiry stay disabled; unmanaged copies require operator handling.

acceptance.title: Identity-provider sign-in
acceptance.evidence: GitHub OAuth/PKCE and role removal pass mock tests. Live acceptance requires OAuth app settings.

acceptance.title: Distributed durable job coordination
acceptance.evidence: SQLite/PostgreSQL process races, crash rollback, fenced retries and browser workflows pass. One API plus offline workers; production multi-host qualification remains pending.

acceptance.title: Docker deployment verification
acceptance.evidence: Build and run the image, then exercise persistence and health checks.

acceptance.title: Remote CI execution
acceptance.evidence: A successful local run does not establish remote CI success.

acceptance.title: Load, recovery and upgrade acceptance
acceptance.evidence: Local load smoke, restore and migrations pass. Production capacity and deployment recovery remain unverified.
